title: Confirm or reject a quote
summary: When the patient accepts it, it's confirmed (and can be invoiced); if not, it's rejected with a reason.

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Quotes
steps.details: The treatment plan with prices for the patient to approve; once confirmed it's invoiced, booked and charged.

steps.title: Open the quote
steps.details: Tap the quote in the list. The guide continues once its details open.

steps.title: Reject
steps.details: It asks for a reason, which stays visible on the quote.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.details: It asks for confirmation before applying.

steps.title: Confirm quote
steps.details: Once confirmed it can't be edited: it's invoiced, booked and creates the treatment plan.
